title: Elixir of Dragonborn Prowess: Poison
summary: Until Long Rest, gain Poison resistance, advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion checks, and one cast of Ray of Sickness.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Until Long Rest, gain Poison resistance, advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion checks, and one cast of Ray of Sickness.
fields.Acquisition: Trade green dragonborn blood to Araj Oblodra in Moonrise Towers or the Lower City.
fields.Stacking: Araj’s elixirs stack with ordinary elixirs and other Araj elixirs.
fields.Ray of Sickness: Action. Make a ranged spell attack out to 60 ft for 2d8 Poison. On a hit, a Constitution save resists 2 turns of Poisoned.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Verified card mechanics against the cited item or linked rule.
